method: dataprep/room_gt.py: laser stations inside the captured room, sharpest-histogram yaw, floor/ceiling = strongest horizontal planes, each main wall = strongest range^2-weighted plane in a manually chosen window (W:-1.60:-1.50,E:1.21:1.31,S:-0.50:-0.40,N:2.47:2.57)
note: Non-rectangular: clipped (diagonal) north-east corner; closet recess on the south side. Each main face covers about 60 % of its side.
openings_method: dataprep/openings_gt.py: openings marked roughly on laser elevation images by a person, edges snapped to the laser wall (50 % solid-share crossing, 1 cm columns)
